prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean a spray (airbrush) tan or a UV/booth tan? Preferences (budget, how close to central Pleasanton, whether you want a boutique studio vs. chain) will change the recommendation.

If you’re not sure yet, here’s a quick way to pick the best salon and a couple of common good options to look for:

How to choose the best tanning salon
- Decide spray vs. UV: spray gives immediate, safer color; UV booths risk skin damage.  
- Check recent reviews on Google Maps and Yelp (look for consistent 4+ stars and recent dates).  
- Cleanliness and staff training: photos, reviews mentioning sanitation and technician skill.  
- Products & options: custom airbrush, organic solutions, express options, different bed levels.  
- Price and packages: compare single sessions vs. memberships and look for first-time specials.  
- Ask about technician certification and patch test policy (for spray tans).

Places commonly recommended (check current reviews)
- Local boutique spray/airbrush studios — often give the most natural results and personalized service. Search “spray tan Pleasanton” or “airbrush tan Pleasanton.”  
- Palm Beach Tan (chain) — commonly found in the area and known for modern booths and consistent hygiene.  
- Med-spa or esthetician-run salons — good if you want a more professional, customized spray tan.

If you tell me spray vs. UV, your exact neighborhood in Pleasanton, or whether you prefer chain vs. boutique, I’ll give more specific names and tips on what to ask when you call. I can also walk you through how to check Yelp/Google results step‑by‑step.
